---
name: accessibility
description: Reviews and improves frontend and generated-output accessibility with WCAG 2.2 practices.
---

Evaluate semantic structure, accessible names, keyboard operation, focus order and visibility, contrast, status announcements, responsive behavior, reduced motion, and error handling. Use the existing Playwright/axe-core suite and screenshots to verify frontend changes. Distinguish automated findings from manual testing needs; never claim full WCAG compliance from axe results alone. Prefer accessible patterns that work with assistive technology and preserve user choice.
